q: What is the remainder when 7<sup>2026</sup> is divided by 100?
sol: Powers of 7 mod 100 cycle every 4: 07, 49, 43, 01. 2026 mod 4 = 2, so the remainder matches 7² = 49.

q: N = 2³ × 3⁴ × 5². How many factors of N are perfect squares?
sol: A perfect-square factor needs even exponents: 2^{0,2} (2 ways), 3^{0,2,4} (3 ways), 5^{0,2} (2 ways) → 2×3×2 = 12.

q: The HCF of two numbers is 12 and their LCM is 720. If one of the numbers is 144, find the other.
sol: Product of numbers = HCF × LCM = 12 × 720 = 8640. Other number = 8640 / 144 = 60.
